mapper.sql: cycle_products.id AS id, cycle_products.reference AS adj, cycle_products.date AS `date`, cycle_products.company_id AS companyId, companies.name AS companyName, cycle_products.deposit_to AS depositTo, cycle_products.location_group_id AS warehouseId, location_groups.name AS warehouseName, cycle_products.adj_type AS `type`, cycle_products.deposit_to AS adjustmentId, CONCAT(chart_accounts.account_codes, ' - ', chart_accounts.account_description) AS adjustment, cycle_products.pgroup_id AS productGroupId, pgroups.name AS productGroupName, cycle_products.note AS note, cycle_products.status AS status, cycle_products.created AS created, cycle_products.modified AS modified, CONCAT(users1.first_name, ' ', users1.last_name) AS createdBy, CONCAT(users2.first_name, ' ', users2.last_name) AS modifiedBy

FROM cycle_products LEFT JOIN companies ON cycle_products.company_id = companies.id LEFT JOIN location_groups ON cycle_products.location_group_id = location_groups.id LEFT JOIN chart_accounts ON cycle_products.deposit_to = chart_accounts.id LEFT JOIN pgroups ON cycle_products.pgroup_id = pgroups.id LEFT JOIN users AS users1 ON users1.id = cycle_products.created_by LEFT JOIN users AS users2 ON users2.id = cycle_products.modified_by
mapper.select: SELECT cycle_product_details.id AS id, cycle_product_details.cycle_product_id AS inventoryAdjustmentId, cycle_product_details.product_id AS productId, IFNULL(cycle_product_details.lots_number,'0') AS lotsNumber, products.code AS sku, products.barcode AS upc, products.price_uom_id AS uomId, products.unit_cost AS unitCost, uoms.name AS uomName, uoms.abbr AS uomAbbr, products.name AS productName, products.is_expired_date AS isExpiredDate, cycle_product_details.location_id AS locationId, locations.name AS locationName, cycle_product_details.expired_date AS expiredDate, cycle_product_details.current_qty AS qtyOnhand, cycle_product_details.new_qty AS newQty, cycle_product_details.qty_difference AS adjustQty FROM cycle_product_details LEFT JOIN products ON cycle_product_details.product_id = products.id LEFT JOIN uoms ON products.price_uom_id = uoms.id LEFT JOIN locations ON cycle_product_details.location_id = locations.id WHERE cycle_product_details.cycle_product_id = #{inventoryAdjustmentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cycle_products ( `date`, company_id, location_group_id, pgroup_id, deposit_to, reference, note, created_by, created, adj_type, cp_type, status ) VALUES ( #{inventoryAdjustment.date}, #{inventoryAdjustment.companyId}, #{inventoryAdjustment.warehouseId}, #{inventoryAdjustment.productGroupId}, #{inventoryAdjustment.depositTo}, #{inventoryAdjustment.reference}, #{inventoryAdjustment.note}, #{inventoryAdjustment.createdBy}, NOW(), #{inventoryAdjustment.type}, #{inventoryAdjustment.cpType}, #{inventoryAdjustment.status} )

INSERT INTO cycle_product_details ( cycle_product_id, product_id, location_id, expired_date, lots_number, current_qty, new_qty, qty_difference ) VALUES ( #{inventoryAdjustmentDetail.cycleProductId}, #{inventoryAdjustmentDetail.productId}, #{inventoryAdjustmentDetail.locationId}, #{inventoryAdjustmentDetail.expiredDate}, #{inventoryAdjustmentDetail.lotNumber}, #{inventoryAdjustmentDetail.currentQty}, #{inventoryAdjustmentDetail.newQty}, #{inventoryAdjustmentDetail.qtyDifference} )
mapper.update: INSERT INTO cycle_products ( `date`, company_id, location_group_id, pgroup_id, deposit_to, reference, note, cp_type, adj_type, created_by, created ) VALUES ( #{inventoryAdjustment.date}, #{inventoryAdjustment.companyId}, #{inventoryAdjustment.warehouseId}, #{inventoryAdjustment.productGroupId}, #{inventoryAdjustment.depositTo}, #{inventoryAdjustment.reference}, #{inventoryAdjustment.note}, #{inventoryAdjustment.cpType}, #{inventoryAdjustment.type}, #{inventoryAdjustment.modifiedBy}, NOW() )

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ${tblName} ( transfer_order_id, purchase_return_id, purchase_order_id, type, customer_id, vendor_id, product_id, location_group_id, location_id, qty, unit_cost, date, lots_number, date_expired, created, created_by, modified, modified_by ) VALUES ( #{globalStock.transferOrderId}, #{globalStock.purchaseReturnId}, #{globalStock.purchaseOrderId}, #{globalStock.type}, #{globalStock.customerId}, #{globalStock.vendorId}, #{globalStock.productId}, #{globalStock.warehouseId}, #{globalStock.locationId}, #{globalStock.totalQty} * -1, #{globalStock.unitCost}, NOW(), #{globalStock.lotsNumber}, #{globalStock.expiredDate}, NOW(), #{globalStock.createdBy}, NOW(), #{globalStock.createdBy} )

INSERT INTO inventories ( cycle_product_id, cycle_product_detail_id, purchase_order_id, purchase_return_id, purchase_receive_result_id, transfer_order_id, type, customer_id, vendor_id, product_id, location_group_id, location_id, qty, unit_cost, date, lots_number, date_expired, created, created_by, modified, modified_by ) VALUES ( #{globalStock.cycleProductId}, #{globalStock.cycleProductDetailId}, #{globalStock.purchaseOrderId}, #{globalStock.purchaseReturnId}, #{globalStock.purchaseReceiveResultId}, #{globalStock.transferOrderId}, #{globalStock.type}, #{globalStock.customerId}, #{globalStock.vendorId}, #{globalStock.productId}, #{globalStock.warehouseId}, #{globalStock.locationId}, #{globalStock.totalQty} * -1, #{globalStock.unitCost}, NOW(), #{globalStock.lotsNumber}, #{globalStock.expiredDate}, NOW(), #{globalStock.createdBy}, NOW(), #{globalStock.createdBy} )
mapper.update: UPDATE inventory_totals SET total_qty = 0, total_order = 0, total_pb = 0, total_cycle = 0, total_pbc = 0 WHERE product_id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT product_id FROM inventories WHERE location_group_id = #{warehouseId} )
mapper.select:
SELECT total_qty FROM ${tableName} WHERE product_id = #{filter.productId} AND lots_number = (SELECT lots_number FROM ${tableName} WHERE product_id = #{filter.productId} ORDER BY product_id DESC LIMIT 1)
AND expired_date = (SELECT expired_date FROM ${tableName} WHERE product_id = #{filter.productId} ORDER BY product_id DESC LIMIT 1)
GROUP BY product_id
, expired_date

SELECT gt.product_id AS productId, p.name AS productName, p.code AS sku, p.barcode AS upc, p.is_expired_date AS isExpiredDate, p.price_uom_id AS uomId, uoms.name AS uomName, uoms.abbr AS uomAbbr, gt.location_id AS locationId, locations.name AS locationName, gt.expired_date AS expiredDate, SUM(gt.total_qty) - SUM(gt.total_order) AS qtyOnHand FROM ${tableName} AS gt INNER JOIN products AS p ON p.id = gt.product_id LEFT JOIN locations ON locations.id = gt.location_id LEFT JOIN uoms ON uoms.id = p.price_uom_id WHERE p.is_active = 1 GROUP BY gt.product_id, p.name, p.code, p.barcode, p.price_uom_id, uoms.abbr HAVING qtyOnHand > 0 ORDER BY p.code ASC
